stock.description: Diwang Industrial Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, with core activities encompassing the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of specialized coating agents and synthetic resins. The company's geographical reach extends to the People's Republic of China, Mexico, Turkey, and Vietnam. Its product portfolio features a diverse range of colourants, finishes, and additives, which are vital components across various industries, including apparel, footwear, handbags, automobile interior decoration, home furnishings, and sports equipment. Founded in 2003, the company was formerly known as Sunlight Technology Holdings Limited until it officially adopted its current name, Diwang Industrial Holdings Limited, in May 2022. The corporate headquarters are located in Hangzhou, People's Republic of China.
